status: Final secondary robustness pass after the primary study; all final networks included, no new training or tuning.

recovery.target: fresh independent draws of the same sparse clean bits, held fixed under fresh Gaussian observation noise
recovery.matching: same fresh latent examples, contexts and standard observation noise across both families and every network
recovery.interpretation: Independent sampled-observation validation; discrete clean bit patterns may recur in the training distribution. Summarize initialization seeds separately.

partner_state.models: all final networks in both families
partner_state.backgrounds: same four original backgrounds and contexts, with only the two partner bits reset together to 0 or 1; pair itself absent
partner_state.reason: Original backgrounds have partners active in only one of four cases; medians can hide that conditional dependence. This paired intervention keeps all other context fixed.
partner_state.limits: This does not add a new task or identify an error-correction module. Partner activity can change individual response curves as well as joint computation.

stopping_rule: Finish these fixed validation inputs and partner-state controls, complete independent checks, plots and the findings note. No further experiments in this run.
